why: Laya is deterministic per (state, question): repeating an identical call moves the
probability by 0.000000. Rewriting the same question moves it by up to 0.32 -- more
than any threshold in use. The question text is therefore part of the interface, not
a comment: it is frozen verbatim here and versioned with the server.
Every tool response echoes the wording used plus its sha256, so a silent rewrite is
visible in the transcript instead of being absorbed into the score.
Changing any string below requires a new registry_version and a fresh stability run.
